experiment: E08 sub-experiments C/D/E (capacity/prices, switching stability, causality/budget/architecture audit gates)
synthetic_scope: All numbers come from small synthetic CPU instances constructed for mechanism verification and falsification (plan E08 sections 4-6). They validate or refute controller properties (feasibility, causality, ledger correctness, switching stability). They are not evidence that any mechanism helps natural-language modeling, and no language-model training was performed.

c1.description: C1 fixed-state capacity solver verification; values, potentials, social cost and feasibility computed exactly; dummy/stop action has explicit cost and is never silent.

c2.description: C2 drifting-value empirical stability. Prices update per batch; value drift applies after each round of executed expert calls. No fixed-problem theorem is transferred to this dynamic setting.

d1.description: D1 C6 switching counterexample in float64; routes compared at lengths 1,2,4,8,16,32 with product spectral radii; stabilizers: residual damping, spectral-NORM scaling (not spectral radius), switching-graph constraint.

switching_graph_constraint.constraint: only self-transitions allowed (no A<->B switches); the expanding combination is forbidden

d2.reason: Plan sec.1: run CPU exact counterexamples first and pick learning experiments only after main-line problems appear. Plan sec.5 (D3) gate: invest only if the real model shows (a) systematic NLL degradation with longer loops, (b) clear numerical-stability differences across expert sequences, or (c) the controller repeatedly choosing reproducible expansion paths. None of these signals is present in this run, so the small learning-expert prototype (D2) is intentionally not executed.

e1.description: E1 prefix-invariance audit: fixed prefix positions 0..2, suffix swapped between two designed score matrices; per-layer prefix routes and prefix logits compared in float64 with fixed positions and no dropout. Violations disqualify a rule from causal autoregressive deployment (system-level shared congestion is a separate issue from same-sequence future-token information).

e2.description: E2 execution-layer budget ledger: per-step new calls, cumulative calls, budget and remaining quota are recorded where experts actually execute. C8 shows the published Online SeqTopK rule can execute 3 calls against an mK=2 budget while a top-set-length inference reports 2; the ledger fix restores the guarantee.

counting_metrics.note: each counting basis is reported separately; branch/search compute must be charged to generation-label or deployment cost as appropriate

e3.description: E3 order/architecture separation: A->B, B->A, A->A, B->B and parallel mixes compared with all parameters fixed; router comparisons share the identical compute structure, architecture comparisons are reported in a separate table; Top-2 candidates over 8 experts are counted and labeled as 28 pairs, never as 8 independent actions.

router_comparison.structure: serial two Top-1 calls, identical experts/parameters/compute; only the selection order changes

architecture_comparison.note: separate table: architectures differ in composition, depth and kernels; equal expert-call count does not make them the same function class
